newsitem.title: USA: Innovex sees Q1 results exceeding views.
newsitem.headline: Innovex sees Q1 results exceeding views.

text.p: Innovex Inc said Wednesday it expects revenues and earnings per share for the first quarter to be up significantly from a year ago, exceeding analysts' expectations.
Innovex said it believes net earnings for the first quarter ending December 31 will exceed the high end of the range of current analysts' estimates by about 20 to 25 percent.
The company did not specify the range of estimates.
Later, the company said analysts' earnings estimates for the first quarter range from $0.50 a share to a high of $0.61.

"Innovex's strong first quarter performance resulted principally from greater than expected demand for lead wires for magneto-resistive heads, including our WAT (wire alignment tab) product," Thomas Haley, chairman, said in a statement.
He added that gross margins have returned to target levels sooner than had been initially expected.
Innovex said it expects to release its first quarter earnings around January 15.
Innovex makes electrical components for computer electronics, including hard drives, and medical instrument markets. It also develops computer software.
